title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — Reductions of Coinsurance Charges for Reversed Covered Days
content:
When covered days of a booked coinsurance block are reversed after the coinsurance on them was charged, Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage reduces the charge for those days under the reversal's own reason. The reduction for reversed covered days on a resident coinsurance charge applies to the resident's original coinsurance charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block, for the days of the uncertified-day reversal posted against that block's booked-days entry after the charge was posted. It falls due once such a reversal stands on the episode.

**When the reduction is fixed.** A reduction for reversed covered days on a resident coinsurance charge is fixed only after the records carry a rate-year correction against that charge whenever the charge's recorded daily rate is above the rate of the year in which its days were furnished and its days take a resident share above nothing under the split in effect on them.

## Reduction tool: `reduce_coinsurance_for_reversed_days_0894f336`

**Capability.** Posts the reduction of one coinsurance charge on a Medicare Part A coverage episode for booked covered days that one day reversal took back. One call adds one adjustment entry dated today, naming the charge it reduces and carrying over from the named day reversal its booked-days entry, its service month and its own reason, and lowers the episode's open coinsurance balance by the amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `medicare_coverage_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Part A coverage episode the charge belongs to, as shown by the coverage episode lookup for the resident | Id |
| `charge_entry_id` | The reference number of the coinsurance charge entry being reduced, as shown in the episode's Medicare billing history | Id |
| `reversal_entry_id` | The reference number of the day reversal entry whose reversed days the reduction is for, as shown in the episode's Medicare billing history | Id |
| `amount` | The reduction | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, passed already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt reads: status "adjusted" (the reduction entry now stands on the account); the adjustment entry's reference number; the charge reduced; the adjustment reason carried over from the day reversal; the reduction posted; today's posting date (YYYY-MM-DD); and the episode's open coinsurance balance across every liable party including this reduction. A non-positive amount returns an error.
